answer: Independent meter attestation. An identity stays valid only while a utility meter at a distinct service address signs heartbeats and reports continuous draw above a floor. A single operator cannot mint identities without separate metered sites, so each costs installation, deposit, and minimum monthly consumption. Meters stream readings through a river of time-stamped packets. Any gap severs the identity's thread of validity. A tiny ember of standby load must persist or the address is retired. Attacker pays site lease plus meter fees per identity.
